speaker: Glade Spirit
text: Welcome, traveler from the waking world. Few find their way here.

speaker: Glade Spirit
text: The crystals remember everything. Every joy, every sorrow, every soul that has passed through.

speaker: Glade Spirit
text: But something dark stirs in the deeper reaches. The Nightmare Core grows stronger.

speaker: Glade Spirit
text: Brave words. Seek the Dreamspire Temple — the seers there may know its weakness.

speaker: Glade Spirit
text: A mass of nightmares given form. It feeds on fear and corrupts the dream paths. The Temple seers know more.

speaker: Temple Seer
text: The Nightmare Core was once a guardian of this realm. It fell to corruption when the rift opened.

speaker: Temple Seer
text: To reach it, you must pass through the Shimmering Grotto and cross the Floating Isles.

speaker: Temple Seer
text: Be warned — the deeper you go, the stronger the nightmares become. Prepare well.

speaker: Dream Merchant
text: Wares from beyond the veil! Crystal dust, dream shards, and things that don't quite exist.

speaker: Dream Merchant
text: Everything here has a price, but not always in gold. Sometimes memories will do.

speaker: Dream Merchant
text: A discerning customer! Browse at your leisure.

speaker: Dream Merchant
text: The door is always open, traveler. Or is it? Hard to tell in this place.
